arms.continuous: ContinuousDynamics at frozen width 456; no symbolic modules
arms.hybrid: CNNHybridPredictor port; micro contact+velocity-bin symbolic conditioning; macro head and adapter receive no CLEVRER gradient and are never evaluated (unsupported Phase 0)

definitions.comparator_disclosure: continuous_h5 selection optimism (#74, selection_optimism=true) attaches to the NovPhy family only; here both arms are retrained from scratch with no policy selection and every contrast discloses independent training

endpoint_grid.divisibility_rule: every endpoint divisible by all horizons and context+endpoint within the 128-frame clip; the NovPhy {15..600} grid does not transfer because 600 exceeds the clip; divisibility is the freezing rule

estimands.dropped: planning/ranking regret is NOT an estimand on CLEVRER (no candidate inventory); no shots/success claims; the macro arm is unsupported and its estimand dropped
estimands.recursive: fixed-pair rollout from the true carrier at each eval context; one shared initial carrier, predictions feed the next transition, no truth resets
estimands.regime: contact-active = at least one collision event inside the early cascade window (context, context+30]; strata contrasts of the symbolic-execution effect per horizon and endpoint; minimum 8 units per stratum
estimands.symbolic_execution: hybrid fixed micro pair h vs hybrid fixed continuous pair h (same checkpoint)
estimands.training_effect: hybrid fixed continuous pair h vs independently trained continuous arm at h
estimands.zero_shot_pooling: no zero-shot or adapted conditions exist here; both arms retrained from scratch

definitions.intervals: paired bootstrap over paired (scene, context) units, mean-over-seeds reference-minus-tested differences, 10000 resamples, rng 7201; DESCRIPTIVE only, no inferential superiority claim

training.identical_minibatches: both arms of one seed share the generator seed and the frozen window order; windows draw with one per-seed generator exactly as issue-74

objective.dropped: none; the issue-74 objective contains no action-dependent penalty term; the action enters only as the constant null-action conditioning input held for both arms
objective.hybrid_symbolic: 0.1 x micro symbolic losses: pos-weight-5 relations BCE over the contact and velocity-bin channels plus availability BCE, at predicted and observed contexts
retained: local carrier MSE at four requested-horizon transitions
recursive MSE along the unrolled carrier

training.pair_cycle: step % 6 over frozen issue-71 PAIRS order minus macro: [[1, 'continuous'], [1, 'micro'], [5, 'continuous'], [5, 'micro'], [15, 'continuous'], [15, 'micro']]; the continuous arm uses the same delta with continuous abstraction

limitations: out-of-family replication: mechanism-shape evidence only, no leaderboard/VQA or perception claim
engine-annotation features in, no visual perception on either arm; shared frozen parser contract
descriptive paired bootstrap over 48 (scene, context) units per seed; no inferential superiority claim
inference and symbolic-head work are not equalized across arms; recorded, not matched
macro arm unsupported on CLEVRER; its estimand dropped (Phase 0)

membership.rule: first 12 collision-complete scenes in ascending scene_index within the validation-split annotations; collision-complete = contiguous 128-frame trajectory for every declared object and at least one collision event; no outcome-based selection

representation.availability_mask: inside_camera_view in columns 7 and 10; unavailable fields zeroed; all masked estimands
representation.carrier: unchanged issue-71 236-value layout: 2 global values + 18 slots x 13 columns
representation.macro_note: no supports/structure-unstable referent on CLEVRER; macro pairs are never trained and never evaluated; the macro estimand is DROPPED, no invented vocabulary

micro_predicates.contact: collision events (frame_id, object_ids) label symmetric channel 0
micro_predicates.velocity_bin: same speed tier at frozen edges [0.3499, 1.6807], symmetric channel 1

representation.parser_symmetry: identical frozen annotation-to-carrier builder for both arms; engine features in, predicates out; no learned perception on either side
representation.slot_contract: 18 fixed slots; declared CLEVRER objects occupy slots 0..n-1 in object_id order for every frame; remaining slots stay zero; identical builder for both arms (symmetric Phase-0 declaration)
representation.unmapped_fields: vertical location/velocity, orientation matrices and angular velocities are parsed into per-scene shards for the parser-contract record with no carrier column referent
